name: number_to_word
description: Write a small integer (or a sum result) as an English number word. Control: same format asking for the digit form.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
W=['zero','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine','ten','eleven','twelve']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
    a=random.randint(0,6);b=random.randint(0,6)
    items.append({"prompt":f"Q: Write the result of {a} + {b} as an English word.\nA: The word is","answer":" "+W[a+b]})
    a=random.randint(0,6);b=random.randint(0,6)
    control.append({"prompt":f"Q: Write the result of {a} + {b} as a numeral.\nA: The numeral is","answer":" "+str(a+b)})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
